nodes.name: Ni BDC MOF Synthesis
nodes.procedure: Ion-permeable thin single-crystal Ni BDC MOF sheets were synthesized, as confirmed by XRD, SEM, TEM, FTIR, Raman and XPS spectra (Figure S2, Supporting Information).
nodes.source_text: To achieve fine structure tailoring, ion-permeable thin single-crystal Ni BDC MOF sheets were synthesized, as confirmed by XRD, SEM, TEM, FTIR, Raman and XPS spectra (Figure S2, Supporting Information).

nodes.name: Base Etching
nodes.procedure: Directly soaking of Ni BDC MOFs in 1.0 M KOH will produce β-Ni(OH)₂.
nodes.source_text: Instead of the synergistic effect, directly soaking of Ni BDC MOFs in 1.0 M KOH will produce β-Ni(OH)₂...

nodes.name: Electrooxidation of β-Ni(OH)₂
nodes.procedure: The electrooxidation of β-Ni(OH)₂ was also performed at 1.7 V vs. RHE in a 1.0 M KOH basic electrolyte to produce γ-NiOOH with intercalated hydrated K⁺ ions.
nodes.source_text: The electrooxidation of β-Ni(OH)₂ was also performed at 1.7 V vs. RHE in a 1.0 M KOH basic electrolyte...

nodes.name: One-Step Base Etching-Assisted Electrooxidation
nodes.procedure: The Ni BDC MOF template was electrochemically treated at a high anodic potential of 1.7 V vs. RHE in 1.0 M KOH basic electrolyte. During electrochemical treatment, base etching is responsible for removing the BDC ligands of both Ni_aO₆ and Ni_bO₆ units, and a high anodic potential ensures the bridging of Ni_bO₆ units along the b-axis.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiO_x(OH)_y exhibits crystallographic structure similar to single-phase layered γ-NiOOH (PDF#06-0075) with slightly larger interlayer expansion than γ-NiOOH, shown by shift of (003), (006), (102) peaks toward lower 2θ angles. FWHM values similar: (003) 0.762° vs 0.726°, (006) 0.702° vs 0.707°, (102) 0.717° vs 0.701°.
nodes.evidence_snippet: XRD analysis (Figure 2a) indicated that the product exhibited a crystallographic structure similar to the single-phase layered γ -NiOOH (PDF#06-0075), suggesting the successful phase transformation... The XRD patterns (Figure 2a) showed that slightly larger interlayer expansion for NiO_x(OH)_y than γ -NiOOH was demonstrated by the shift of c-axis facets... We calculated the full width at half maxima (FWHM) of these XRD peaks. The FWHM of (003), (006), and (102) facet is 0.762, 0.702, and 0.717 degree for NiO_x(OH)_y and 0.726, 0.707, and 0.701 degree for γ -NiOOH...

nodes.characterization_summary: γ-NiOOH shows E_g mode at 474 cm⁻¹ and A_1g mode at 552 cm⁻¹ for [NiO₂] framework NiO₆ units. NiO_x(OH)_y shows same bands plus new E_g at 490 cm⁻¹ and A_1g at 566 cm⁻¹ for intercalated NiO₆ units with higher wavenumbers.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Raman spectrum of γ -NiOOH (Figure 2b) exhibited the depolarized E_g mode at 474 cm⁻¹ and polarized A_{lg} mode at 552 cm⁻¹ for the NiO_6 units in the [NiO_2] framework. The same bands at 474 and 552 cm⁻¹ in NiO_x(OH)_y confirm... two new higher-wavenumber pairing bands at 490 and 566 cm⁻¹ in NiO_x(OH)_y can also be assigned to the E_g and A_{lg} modes of the NiO_6 units.

nodes.characterization_summary: γ-NiOOH: Ni-O at 1.0-2.0 Å (6-coordinated, split by Jahn-Teller: 1.86 Å xy-plane, 2.01 Å z-axis), Ni-Ni/Ni-O second shell at 2.0-3.0 Å. NiO_x(OH)_y: two Ni-O peaks at 1.0-2.0 Å (total CN=6), WT shows 1.89 Å (Ni_bO₆ [NiO₂]) and 2.05 Å (Ni_aO₆ intercalated + Ni-O_z-axis), ~35% Ni_aO₆/Ni_bO₆ ratio.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in the Fourier transforms of the extended X-ray absorption fine structure (EXAFS, Figure 2c; Table S2, Supporting Information), for γ -NiOOH, the peak at 1.0 - 2.0 Å was assigned to scattering of the nearest 6-coordinated Ni-O atoms... However, for NiO_x(OH)_y ... two peaks at 1.0 - 2.0 Å were a result of two types of NiO_6 units... suggesting about 35% ratio for Ni_aO_6 to Ni_bO_6 units.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni 2p_{3/2}: NiO_x(OH)_y at ~855.5 eV (lower valence Ni^{δ+}, δ<3) vs γ-NiOOH at 855.7 eV (Ni^{3+}). O 1s: Ni-O 529.1 eV, Ni-OH 530.8 eV, H₂O 533 eV; S_{Ni-OH}/S_{Ni-O} = 4.05 (NiO_x(OH)_y) vs 3.57 (γ-NiOOH).

O 1s XPS core-level spectra (Figure 4b) can be deconvoluted to three peaks. Binding energies at 529.1, 530.8, and 533 eV... higher peak area ratio of Ni - OH to Ni - O (S_{Ni - OH} / S_{Ni - O}) for NiO_x(OH)_y (4.05) than γ NiOOH (3.57)
